arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: the side that brought the case's counsel argued the instruction restricts mitigation to pre-crime facts.
the opposing side's counsel argued the case does not turn on factor (k) alone.

Justice Kennedy asked if the instruction mandates a single moral determination.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The dispute centers on California's penalty-phase instruction. the side that brought the case claims it restricts jurors to pre-crime facts. the opposing side argues it permits broad moral judgment.
